description: Block git force pushes before they run: --force and its variants (--force-with-lease, --force-if-includes), -f alone or combined (-uf) and +refspecs (git push origin +main), also with git -C/-c options, a path to git, inside bash -c or in a chained command. Branch names that contain -f (my-feature) are not blocked. It errs on the side of blocking: a commit message that quotes a force push is blocked too. A guardrail, not a security boundary: git aliases and shell variables are not followed. Reads the command with jq when installed, otherwise matches the raw hook input.

hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null) || cmd=$input; if printf '%s\n' "$cmd" | grep -Eq '(^|[[:space:];\&|("'"'"'`/\\]|\\n)git([[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]+([[:space:]]+[^-[:space:]][^[:space:]]*)?)*[[:space:]]+push([[:space:]]+[^;&|[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+(--force([-=][^[:space:]]*)?|-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*|\+[^[:space:]]+)([[:space:];\&|)"'"'"'`\\]|$)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Force push is blocked by hook (--force, --force-with-lease, -f or a +refspec)"}}'; fi
